question_ar: هل رسم استطلاع الموقع 20 دينار/م.ط (ص.93) هو الرسم الذي يدفعه الزبون للمكتب، وهل 150 فلس/م.ط (ص.96) هو رسم النقابة الذي يُضاف؟
question_en: Is the 20 JOD/lm on p.93 the office fee to be billed to the client and the 150 fils/lm on p.96 a JEA-imposed surcharge on top?
proposed_answers: (A) 20 JOD/lm office + 0.15 JOD/lm syndicate + 1% on total (as manual literally reads). (B) 150 fils/lm is a per-unit fee that JEA passes through to the office (unlikely reading).
evidence_needed_from_JEA: official JEA clarification of fee-schedule interpretation on ch7 §1.هـ and §4.أ.2

question_ar: ما هي قاعدة تقريب الكسور (2/3 حفر تجريبية و 1/3 آبار سبرية) في ص.239؟
question_en: What is the rounding rule for the 2/3 test-pits and 1/3 boreholes fractions on p.239?
proposed_answers: CEILING / FLOOR / DISTRIBUTION_PRESERVING_TOTAL / reviewer-determined per case
evidence_needed_from_JEA: JEA clarification whether integer allocation is deterministic or per-case reviewer decision

question_ar: هل حالة ADDITION_ABOVE_EXISTING تنتمي إلى SRV-002 أم SRV-010 (إعادة تصديق مع إضافات)؟
question_en: Does ADDITION_ABOVE_EXISTING map to SRV-002 (existing-building survey) or SRV-010 (survey re-approval with additions)?
proposed_answers: (A) SRV-010 as workflow with SRV-002 §ب content as inputs. (B) SRV-002 covers all p.239 §ب including additions. (C) Both — SRV-010 for the re-approval workflow with SRV-002 §ب content pre-populated.
evidence_needed_from_JEA: JEA clarification of the service-boundary for building additions

question_ar: هل SRV-002 §ب item 7 (التقرير الفني الإنشائي) هو نفس تقرير SRV-009؟
question_en: Is SRV-002 §ب item 7 (structural technical report) the same as SRV-009 deliverable?
proposed_answers: (A) SRV-009 IS the deliverable that SRV-002 §ب references. (B) SRV-002 has its own STRUCTURAL_STUDY report that references SRV-009 lab tests.
evidence_needed_from_JEA: JEA clarification on whether SRV-002 and SRV-009 overlap or are separate

question_ar: ما هو 'السعر المعتمد' لعقد فرق الأمتار في ص.38 §6.م؟
question_en: Which fee schedule does 'السعر المعتمد' refer to for the depth-difference contract on p.38 §6.م?
proposed_answers: (A) Same as base survey office fee (20 JOD/lm per resolved UNQ-001). (B) A separate schedule not in the manual.

question_ar: ما هو المعنى الرسمي لحقل 'المديرية' في نموذج SRV-*؟
question_en: What is the official meaning of the directorate_name field in SRV-* forms?
proposed_answers: (A) دائرة الأراضي (Land Department). (B) المديرية الإدارية (Administrative Directorate). (C) Free text.

question_ar: هل توجد مرحلة كشف موقع من النقابة (JEA site inspection) رسمية في workflow SRV-002 حسب ص.239؟
question_en: Is JEA site inspection a formal workflow stage for SRV-002 per p.239?
proposed_answers: (A) Yes — dedicated stage after second_auditor_review. (B) Handled inside second_auditor_review stage.

question_ar: هل يجب اعتبار floor_count = عدد الطوابق الأقصى + التسويات + السدود + الروف (ص.36 §6.ب) قاعدة إلزامية أم إرشادية؟
question_en: Is the p.36 §6.b floor-count derivation (max + basements + mezzanines + roof-if-small) mandatory or advisory?
proposed_answers: (A) Mandatory — applicant enters components separately and system derives. (B) Advisory — applicant enters derived floor_count directly. (C) Hybrid — both allowed with warnings.
evidence_needed_from_JEA: JEA clarification on binding force of the derivation

question_ar: هل SRV-007 (تصميم تدعيم) وSRV-012 (إشراف تدعيم) خدمتان مستقلتان أم مرحلتان في خدمة واحدة؟
question_en: Are SRV-007 (design) and SRV-012 (supervision) truly separate services or two stages of one service?
proposed_answers: (A) Separate services filed separately. (B) One service with two workflow branches. (C) SRV-007 default with SRV-012 as follow-on when supervising office differs.

question_ar: هل تنطبق على SRV-005 (مشاريع الطاقة) قواعد SRV-001 (المقترحة) الافتراضية أم قواعد خاصة؟
question_en: Do proposed-building rules from SRV-001 apply to SRV-005 (energy projects) by default or are special rules required?
proposed_answers: (A) SRV-001 rules apply with additions from ch5 (renewable energy). (B) SRV-005 has independent rule set.

question_ar: هل ينبغي رفض التقديم عندما تكون المساحة أقل من العتبة (100م² في مركز المحافظة) أم قبوله كتقديم اختياري؟
question_en: Should submission be rejected when area is below applicability threshold or accepted as an optional filing?
proposed_answers: (A) Reject with error message. (B) Accept with warning. (C) Accept silently since rule only says 'when required'.

question_ar: هل توجد قواعد إضافية في الفصل 4 (الإدارة الهندسية) أو الفصل 6 (ترخيص الأبنية القائمة) تؤثر على تدفقات SRV-002؟
question_en: Are there additional rules in Chapter 4 (engineering administration) or Chapter 6 (existing-building licensing) affecting SRV-002 workflows?
proposed_answers: Cannot determine without reading pp.49-90 (Chapter 4+5+6) which are out of Batch 01 scope. Chapter 6 explicitly noted as 'غير مُنفَّذ' in docs/manual-summary.md.
evidence_needed_from_JEA: Read Chapter 6 in a future batch

question_ar: ما هي القواعد الحاكمة لخدمات CERT-006 وMSC-014 التي تظهر في الـseeder ولا تظهر في الـworkbook المؤرشف؟
question_en: What rules govern CERT-006 and MSC-014 which are in the seeder but not in the audited workbook?
proposed_answers: (A) Recent additions to the plan not yet reflected in the workbook. (B) Errors that should be removed from the seeder.
